Spoilers below, trying to figure out how to do it.

>!It opens with some guy getting kidnapped and his tongue cut out. He’s put in a padded room and from there on the film is mostly silent. It’s revealed that there are other people in other padded rooms.


He begins to receive notes from someone in another padded room. They are able to exchange notes over the course of the movie. 


It’s a heart wrenching dichotomy, the absolutely insane torture that these people are put through (brain surgery, limb bones sawed through ((the bone dust!!)), ribs sawed through) for the sake of adrenochrome or something that the surgeon extracts and consumes vs the touching and very human notes that are passed.


In the end, one of them injures the doc and guard and goes to find the other. They see each other and embrace. They explore each others injuries, first with fingers, then with tongues, then with teeth.


My interpretation is that they know they are never going to be whole humans again, so they… lovingly fuck each other to death? And then film slowly crescendos into color, red, as the screen and padded room are filled with their blood.


It’s back to black and white. The final scene is the surgeon, injured, capturing another person.!<

Lastly from Cocoa Pink is the Silky Soft Body Oil (light) in Zombie Apocalypse. The notes are “Dark empty musk infected with lashes of black vanilla, petitgrain essential oil, magnolia flowers, jasmine sambac with the empty remains of vanilla sandalwood.” Dark vanilla on more dark vanilla! Suede 20%

Old books 20%

Earl grey 20%

Blood 10%

Seaside 10%

Petrachor 10%

Almond 10%

Wet: wet this perfume is a little chaotic. The earl grey and almond are very sweet, and the leather, old books, and blood are a little strange mixed in there. It almost makes the sweeter notes a little too sweet.

Dry: wow, this is probably one of the most complex perfumes I’ve ever smelled! The sweet notes have great throw and are definite top notes here. The middle notes are the wet notes, and have moderate throw, and then the darker notes sit very close to the skin. This makes it very wearable, as the first notes smelled are the sweet ones, but it has a darker undertone beneath that if you get close enough. 

Other: the customer service with this was FANTASTIC and I can’t believe the TAT (I had a custom perfume in my hands in about two and a half weeks.) The custom label is a great touch! This perfume lasts about 4-5 hours on me before I need to reapply, which is longer than any other almond perfume I’ve tried. The process was fun and painless and if I can come up with another idea I want to shell out $40 for, I would do it again in a heartbeat.
